description: The bar chart illustrates GLUE performance scores for different fine-tuning methods, shown separately for two RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis contains the categorical fine-tuning methods (left to right: an unlabeled/blurred first category, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, S₅-model) and is labeled “Fine-tuning Method.” The vertical axis is labeled “GLUE Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick labels at 86 and 88 (units not specified), spanning roughly the mid‑84s up to just above 89 based on bar heights. Bars are grouped by method, with two bars per group: a blue bar for “base” and an orange bar for “large,” as indicated by the legend titled “RoBERTa Size” in the upper-left. Approximate values by group are: first (unlabeled) category base ≈84.6 and large ≈85.7; Adaptor base ≈84.4 and large ≈88.1; LoRA base ≈86.6 and large ≈88.9; BitFit base ≈84.3 and large ≈87.7; S₁-model base ≈85.6 and large ≈85.6; S₄-model base ≈86.2 and large ≈87.6; S₅-model base ≈87.0 and large ≈89.2. The categories appear in a fixed method order rather than being sorted by bar height, and no bars are visually emphasized with annotations, outlines, or special shading beyond the two-color encoding.
